name: waterplane
description: Drive the real Claude Code CLI on your desktop from your phone, over Tailscale

paragraphs: An IDE, rethought for the phone in the age of agentic coding. The agent writes the code; what you need in your hand is the steering. waterplane drives the real Claude Code CLI on your own desktop, from the next room or, over Tailscale, from anywhere, and puts the workbench around it: files and diffs, commits and builds, the screenshots it makes, a queue and a schedule, and what every turn costs. And it is made to be customized: a plugin adds the button, switch or status line your way of working needs.
Try the demo · Install · How it compares · Security · MIT · macOS, Linux, Windows via WSL2 · Android app or web app, no iOS app yet
